setlist.title: It's All Over Now, Baby Blue

liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Stella Blue** (2 reviews): Called one of the best 1980s versions, fully developed, with a beautiful Garcia solo in the middle break; Highlight of the set, fully developed and realized [15][19]
- **Brown Eyed Women** (1 review): Reviewer says Garcia's solo here was smoking [17]
- **Help On The Way** (1 review): Help>Slip>Frank possibly the best of the 1983 versions [19]
- **Samson & Delilah** (1 review): Features fiery picking from Jerry Garcia [15]
- **He's Gone** (1 review): Played at a perfect, groovy Dead tempo [15]

## Setlist highlights

- **Happy Birthday Dan Healy**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [26]

## The recordings

- **gd1983-05-15.176407.senn421.blend.wiseman.miller.clugston.flac2496** (recommended): audience recording; 23 songs; 175 min [1]
- **gd1983-05-15.163386.nak304.vita.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 24 songs; 175 min [3]
- **gd83-05-15.sony.keshavan.2217.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 23 songs; 173 min; rated 4.33/5 by 9 [5]. Said about its sound: Keshavan's front-of-board mics sound fuller than most other tapers' mics [25]
- **gd1983-05-15.147899.fob.akg.d330bt.senn421.hecht.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 23 songs; 171 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [6]
- **gd1983-05-15.fob.sonyecm220t.keshavan.miller.94397.sbeok.flac16**: source not stated; 22 songs; 173 min; rated 4.5/5 by 2 [11]. Said about its sound: The three Greek Theatre audience recordings sound very nice [21]
- **gd1983-05-15.set2.nak700.mccue.34167.sbeok.flac16**: source not stated; 14 songs; 110 min; rated 4/5 by 3 [13]. Said about its sound: Second-set-only tape is a clear sound quality upgrade; first set should come from the other source [20]

## Around the show

- Sunny day; crowd eagerly anticipated the recently revived Help on the Way/Slipknot! [16]
- Bob Weir surprised Healy with a birthday song before the second set; Healy was upset, with a gram of coke in his lap [16]
- Garcia could not play the melody to Happy Birthday [22]
- Judged the best run of the Greek shows, part of a Greek, Saratoga, Merriweather run in 1983 [17]
- Reviewer ranks this among the best shows of 1983 [23]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1983-05-15.176407.senn421.blend.wiseman.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Scott Wiseman; transferred by Scott Clugston, Charlie Miller; source: Scott Wiseman's Master Audience Cassettes; Sennheiser 421 mics (x3) > Sony PCM F-1 > Sony D5 (patched out of Dave Kramer & Matt Field) [1]
- **gd1983-05-15.163386.nak304.vita.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Jim Vita; transferred by Scott Clugston, Charlie Miller; source: Master Audience Cassettes; Nakamichi 300 mics + CP4 capsules > Jim Vita's 1st Generation Cassettes [3]. Also: First-generation cassettes from Jim Vita, transferred by Charlie Miller; Keshavan's Sony ECM220t source supplies Touch Of Grey and Minglewood; Sony ECM220t patches also cover Looks Like Rain>Deal, Drums, and the Stella Blue>Throwing Stones transition [3]
- **gd83-05-15.sony.keshavan.2217.sbeok.shnf**: source: FOB Aud Sony ECM 220T > Sony D5 using Fuji Metals no dolby> Played back on a Nak DR1 with Azimuth adjustment > Sony PCMR500 DAT 48KHz SBM ON > PC transfer via… [5]
- **gd1983-05-15.147899.fob.akg.d330bt.senn421.hecht.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Chris Hecht; transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller; source: Chris Hecht's Master (FOB) Audience Cassettes; (2) AKG D330BT mics + (1) Sennheiser 421 > Fostex Mixer > Sony D5M [6]. Also: Keshavan's Sony ECM220T source supplies the first 4:43 of Touch Of Grey plus patches in Franklin's Tower, Drums, and Stones>NFA [6]
- **gd1983-05-15.fob.sonyecm220t.keshavan.miller.94397.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Rango Keshavan; transferred by Charlie Miller; source: (FOB) Sony ECM-220T -> Cassette Master (Sony TC-D5M/Fuji Metal Tape/Dolby B) [11]
- **gd1983-05-15.set2.nak700.mccue.34167.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Unknown; transferred by Mark McCue and Alex Ford; source: 2 Nak 700's > Bass Box EQ > Sony D5 > Sony D5 > Maxell MX 90's [13]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Worthpoint: [Grateful Dead Greek Theater Berkeley poster May 15 1983 | #57193705](https://www.worthpoint.com/worthopedia/grateful-dead-greek-theater-berkeley-57193705) [29]
